title: The introduction · A warning about AI advice

scenes.line: Fourteen free tools. Six were really trials.
scenes.cue: Loud, flat, receipts on the table. Hit 'six'.

scenes.line: Most AI advice is an ad.
scenes.cue: The thesis. Slow down half a step, let it accuse.

scenes.line: The internet's favorite stat? No source.
scenes.cue: Wry. The question mark does the work.

scenes.line: Here, no source means no post.
scenes.cue: The law. Calm, final. Hit 'no post'.
Slowest line in the reel. A door opening, not a pitch.

clean_read: Fourteen free tools. Six were really trials. Most AI advice is an ad. The internet's favorite stat? No source. Here, no source means no post. Comment PLAIN. I'll start you.
notes: Record over the _silent build so the voice doesn't fight the baked SFX; a ducked mix is the alternative.

gate: Say 'nobody can source it' energy in C without claiming the stat is false. The 6/14 and the 80% are AC's own checks (Days 28/25).
